title: Match ADR 0015 claim expiry to the code
body:
ADR 0015:43-45 says a claim depends on the worktree task file only when it exists there, while `src/task/claims.ts:429` expires the claim when the file is missing (review A6); the lock is per network namespace (N8). Decide which is intended and make the ADR and code agree.
Acceptance: ADR text and an executable test state the same expiry rule.
